title: Paying to avoid bad news
hook: Two stated cases: explore the cash cost of information avoidance.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the cash cost of information avoidance affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gain, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the cash cost of information avoidance in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
